subject.title: fix(agents): xAI/Grok requests fail after a stale reasoning replay ("could not decrypt encrypted_content")

question: Should this PR receive a proof exception for xAI's non-inducible code-less stale encrypted_content rotation error?
rationale: ClawSweeper cannot safely mark contributor proof sufficient without maintainer intent because the required after-fix real provider event depends on an organic xAI rotation, while the code path and tests are otherwise strong.

options.title: Accept proof exception
options.body: Treat the redacted pre-fix production logs plus positive and negative unit coverage as sufficient for this non-inducible provider event and proceed with normal merge checks.

options.title: Wait for organic after-fix logs
options.body: Keep the PR blocked until a future xAI rotation produces redacted gateway logs showing the stripped retry succeeds.

options.title: Pause for broader breaker policy
options.body: Defer this narrow fix until maintainers decide whether recoverable provider errors should be handled by a larger circuit-breaker classification design.

recommendation.title: Accept proof exception
recommendation.body: Treat the redacted pre-fix production logs plus positive and negative unit coverage as sufficient for this non-inducible provider event and proceed with normal merge checks.
